origin.description: Guesses from the file without returning the rows. Edition 1 guessing is forced for spec helpers.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Guesses from the file without returning the rows. Edition 1 guessing is forced for spec helpers.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- spec_csv(I("x,y\n1,2\n3.5,a"))
paste(vapply(parsed$cols, function(col) class(col)[1], ""), collapse = ",")

translation.description: Guesses from the file without returning the rows. Edition 1 guessing is forced for spec helpers.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Guesses from the file without returning the rows. Edition 1 guessing is forced for spec helpers.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
parsed = spec_csv(I("x,y\n1,2\n3.5,a"))
return ",".join("collector_" + collector.kind for collector in parsed.cols)
